title: The Week of Water
story: One drop of water has been ice, cloud, river and tea. Follow it for a week — freeze it, dissolve it, watch it fall — and discover why a country of rivers still runs dry.
reward: The Water Watcher seal on your journal — and a rain-gauge design that stays pinned to your world map.

title: Light and the Art of Seeing
story: Light bounces, bends and paints shadows — and your eye catches it all. Chase a beam from a doorway shadow to a lens to the back of your own eye.
reward: The Lenskeeper title — plus your own camera obscura sketch added to the World Gallery.

title: Energy Trails
story: The fan spinning above you started as sunlight, coal or falling water. Trace every joule in your home backwards until you reach the source.
reward: The Energy Tracer badge — and a family energy map you'll actually want to keep.

title: The Story of Your Food
story: Tonight's dal began as a seed in someone's field, rode a truck, met a market, and learned chemistry in your kitchen. Follow one meal all the way back to the soil.
reward: The Farm-to-Plate ribbon — and a hand-drawn food journey map for your journal.

title: Money, Markets and Trust
story: A coin is just metal until everyone agrees it isn't. Barter some snacks, visit a market with new eyes, and find out what money really is.
reward: The Young Economist seal — and a barter-game story worth retelling.

title: Everything That Moves
story: An ant, a bicycle, a train and a planet all obey the same rules. Time them, push them, and learn to predict what motion does next.
reward: The Motion Master title — plus your own speed-and-distance data sheet.

title: The Ocean of Air
story: You live at the bottom of an invisible ocean that presses, swirls and storms. Feel the air push back, then learn why the monsoon arrives on schedule.
reward: The Stormwatcher badge — and a weather log that predicts better than you expected.

title: Worlds Too Small to See
story: Between your fingerprints live cities of cells; inside them, atoms stacked by rules. Shrink down past the microscope's reach and meet the smallest builders of everything.
reward: The Micronaut seal — and powers-of-ten intuition that makes the universe feel navigable.

title: Who Decides? A Democracy Diary
story: From your classroom monitor to Parliament, somebody always decides. Find out how India built a system where the decider is — eventually — you.
reward: The Citizen's Quill — and a mock-election dataset you counted yourself.

title: Patterns Everywhere
story: Tilings in old temples, spirals in sunflowers, sequences in your pocket money — the universe loves repeating itself. Learn to spot the rule behind the pattern.
reward: The Pattern-Seeker ribbon — and a photo-sketch collection of patterns nobody else noticed.

title: The Keepers of Time
story: Before clocks there were shadows, before shadows there were seasons. Build your own timekeepers and find out why every civilisation raced to measure time.
reward: The Timekeeper title — plus a working sundial you built and can explain.

title: Invisible Forces
story: Nothing touches the magnet, yet it moves. Nothing touches the falling mango, yet it falls. Meet the pushes and pulls you cannot see but can absolutely measure.
reward: The Force-Field badge — and an electromagnet you wound yourself.

title: Written in the Family
story: Your earlobes, your dimples, your grandmother's nose — traits travel through families like letters through generations. Learn to read them.
reward: The Genealogist seal — and a family traits chart that starts dinner-table debates.

title: The Kitchen Laboratory
story: Every kitchen is a chemistry lab that doesn't know it. Fizzing sodas, browning onions, soap defeating grease — run the experiments hiding in your own home.
reward: The Kitchen Chemist apron-stamp — and a recipe card of experiments that always work.

title: The Electric City
story: Somewhere a turbine spins, and your room lights up. Follow the wire from a battery-and-bulb circuit all the way to the grid that powers a billion lives.
reward: The Grid-Rider title — and a home wiring map you traced yourself.

title: Where Rivers Begin
story: Civilisations were born on riverbanks for a reason. Chase the monsoon from a warm ocean to your rooftop drain, and learn why every drop is argued over.
reward: The River-Reader seal — and a watershed map of your own neighbourhood.

title: The Sky Watchers
story: Eclipses terrified kings and delighted astronomers — same sky, different knowledge. Track shadows, moon phases and seasons until the sky stops being a ceiling.
reward: The Skywatcher's Lens — and a month of moon sketches that show you predicted the phases.

title: How India Builds
story: A temple arch, a metro line, a brick — all of them are geometry, materials and people organised into something that stands. Look at buildings the way builders do.
reward: The Builder's Square badge — and a scale drawing of a space you know.

title: The Body's Maintenance Crew
story: Your heart beats a hundred thousand times today without being asked. Meet the crew — heart, nerves, lungs, microbes — and learn what keeps the whole operation running.
reward: The Bodywise ribbon — and a personal health-data chart that's honestly interesting.

title: Voices of Freedom
story: Rights are written by people who demanded them. From colonised India to Mandela's prison cell, hear the voices that turned 'unfair' into 'unconstitutional'.
reward: The Freedom Archive stamp — and a letter in your journal to someone who fought for a right you use daily.

title: Journeys, Trade and the Wider World
story: Pepper built empires, cotton made fortunes, and your phone crossed three borders before breakfast. Trace the routes that stitched the world together.
reward: The Route-Master badge — and a traced journey of one object from your home.

title: The Physics of Music
story: Why does a tight string sing higher? Why does a tabla have two drums? Pluck, tap and measure your way from vibrations to ragas.
reward: The Soundsmith seal — and a home-made instrument tuned by physics, not luck.

title: The Data Detectives
story: Elections, budgets, cricket averages — everyone uses numbers to convince you. Learn to collect your own data and decide what it actually says.
reward: The Data Detective badge — and a survey you designed, ran and graphed yourself.

title: The Only Green Planet
story: Earth is the only known rock where forests argue with deserts and win. Meet the web of life around you — and the arithmetic of keeping it alive.
reward: The Green Guardian title — and a biodiversity count of your own street.

title: Nothing Is Lost, Everything Changes
story: Steam, rust, curd, ash — matter never disappears, it only changes costume. Follow the transformations and learn to tell which ones can be undone.
reward: The Alchemist's seal — and a change-diary that sorted physics from chemistry.
